name: Astrocartography
supported: Ten existing DE440s targets; actual apparent equatorial coordinates of date, with explicit system-barycenter mapping
Global MC/IC upper/lower meridian and ASC/DSC geometric horizon branches; circumpolar/grazing/pole diagnostics
Adaptive GeoJSON MultiLineString curves with exact antimeridian splits and declared interpolation tolerance
Same-absolute-UTC natal/relocated frames at explicit destinations, existing six house systems inside |latitude|<60
Selected-point angularity diagnostics and spherical distance to semicircle closure with endpoint classification
Deterministic birth-time sensitivity +/-0-60minutes, explicit IANA/DST folds
JSON/Markdown/GeoJSON CLI and all40 modern compositional planet-axis topic combinations with source links
experimental: Probe-controlled interpolation is tested, not a formal continuous error bound
Pre1972 UTC/UT1/timezone and broad1851-2148 endpoints inherit existing model limitations; four modern epochs independently compared
unsupported: Original Lewis/Irving/Davis coordinate profiles and direct book delineations
Book of Maps original-title-page coauthor resolution; inventory attribution unchanged
Relocation charts at |latitude|>=60; no automatic house-system substitution
Topocentric, refraction, limb/elevation or alternate mean/astrometric coordinate profiles
Parans, local-space lines, complex crossings and geodetic variants
Location desirability ranking, influence probabilities or scientifically verified predictive validity

configuration_matrix.dates: Proleptic Gregorian1851-2148; pinned bundled leap seconds/UT1 modeling, not ancient civil-calendar reconstruction
configuration_matrix.relocation_latitude: strictly (-60,60) degrees; unsupported frames preserve global map output
configuration_matrix.map_latitude: All finite latitudes in (-90,90), excluding geometric grazing endpoints; exact poles queryable only with degenerate flags
configuration_matrix.sampling: Default0.01deg; configurable0.0001-0.1deg plane-altitude residual probes, geographic-linear segments, max initial arc5deg
configuration_matrix.distance: Spherical shortest semicircle-closure distance, radius6371.0088km; not ellipsoidal or a symbolic orb
configuration_matrix.interpretations: modern psychological, compositional only; separate sourced planet and angular-house topics

limits: Four modern epochs, not exhaustive date-range validation.
Swiss and Skyfield use separately modeled UT1; coordinate/time-model differences are included.
Map rendering error is separate from exact-vertex astronomical error.
Numerical agreement does not validate locational symbolism.

P1: Legitimate original-title-page/procedural verification and direct Jim Lewis interpretations
Additional source-scoped relocation rules and permitted published worked examples
Further birth-time, pre1972 and near-polar precision validation; expanded date oracle fixtures
Parans if a named source/convention can be independently verified efficiently
P2: Local-space astrology and explicit azimuth/geodesic conventions
Complex crossings, historical geodetic variants and deeper paran configurations
Advanced visualization and separately source-reviewed location-ranking experiments
licensing: No new runtime dependency; Swiss remains optional reference-only, no Swiss production imports. Existing source/local DE440s and packaging limitations unchanged; no contemporary book/page text or images bundled. pip check clean; no branded certification/endorsement rights inferred.
meaning: Bounded verified mathematical core with useful compositional symbolism; not exhaustive astrocartography or empirical predictive validation.
